# ADR 2: Server-rendered pages plus a JSON API, not a separate front-end build

Status: accepted (baseline template decision)

## Context

Fewer moving parts to secure (one CSP, one session mechanism, one CSRF story) and no separate build step for a small business owner to manage.

## Decision

EJS templates with auto-escaping for pages; the same route registry also serves JSON under `/api` for anything that needs it.

## Consequences

No client-side framework, no bundler, nothing to keep patched beyond the packages in package.json.
